correctness.rationale: A strict affine return-map contraction gives unique disease-free periodic state. Solving two deficit recurrences and integrating produces exact mean identity, with unique AM-GM minimizer. Two pre-pulse deficit functions are strictly oppositely monotone and cross once, giving exact peak-minimizing time and iff equal-fraction coincidence. For three pulses constrained by xyz=exp(-mu T), exact symbolic first derivatives are proportional to p(q-r) and r(q-p), so equal spacing stationary iff p=q=r; a nonzero gradient gives a feasible descent direction for mean susceptibility. Actual included verification.py reproduces all symbolic identities and a strict rational witness F_unequal-F_equal=3/2530. Domain excludes zero pulse strengths and colliding times; no global three-pulse optimizer claimed.

value.rationale: Provides a complete two-pulse mean-invasion optimum for any unequal strengths, a distinct explicit peak-risk optimum (coinciding only for equal strengths), and a sharp qualitative boundary at three campaigns where unequal strengths destroy even local stationarity of equal spacing. The parameter-wide equality criteria and exact three-pulse witness clarify the distinction between Floquet average and instantaneous growth and between fixed campaign efficacy and dose budgets. This structural scheduling result is motivated by pulse vaccination but limited to the disease-free scalar regime; no nonlinear epidemiological consequence is asserted.
